title: Admins Tab
description: Admins Tab documentation for Practice Admin.
overview: This guide covers admins tab workflows for Practice Admin.

subtasks.title: Review the Practice Admins list
subtasks.purpose: See every Practice Admin attached to this practice.

steps.title: Search Practice Admins
steps.description: Use the Search admins… box to filter by name / email.

steps.title: Filter by Status
steps.description: Use the All Status dropdown to filter by Active / Inactive.

steps.title: Sort Admins List
steps.description: Sort by any column header (Status, Name, etc.).

steps.title: Review Admin Audit Logs
steps.description: Click Event Logs at the bottom to see admin-related audit events. Notes The Status chip shows the initial of the state (A = Active, I = Inactive). Deleting the last Active admin is blocked to prevent lock-out.

subtasks.title: Add a Practice Admin
subtasks.purpose: Provision a new Practice Admin for the current practice.

steps.title: Fill Admin Details
steps.description: Fill in Name, Address, Home Phone, Cell Phone, Fax, Email and Username.

steps.title: Save Admin
steps.description: Click Save. Notes Email must be unique across eVitals — reusing an address is blocked. Use the View (eye), Edit (pencil) and Delete (trash) icons in the Action column to manage existing rows. Task 7.4 — Providers Tab
